g.text: One codebase, two worlds. The NFC SDK lives here.
Came with the Flutter kit. Sharper than it looks.
Android side of the SDK. It talks to the chip.
iOS side. The chip answers here too, eventually.
Types in the dark. Catches what you can't see coming.
Heavy, but it holds the API together.
Small, quiet, concurrent. Proxies, balancers, audits.
Runs the models on my own GPU. Nothing phones home.
Everything is written down here. Nothing is forgotten.
Rooms inside rooms. Each one locked the same way.
